name: Normal
internal_synergy: supports the whole team by converting any terrain into a tactical tool

name: Fire
combo_signature: ignites a zone then explodes it
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a pressure vector around a burning front

resistance_rules.description: Fire users take 30% more damage from ice-based skills.

name: Water
combo_signature: floods a route then triggers electric or ice reactions
internal_synergy: links allies through flow and makes every movement a support action

name: Electric
combo_signature: connects multiple targets through a conductive path
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a link in a larger circuit and favors fast burst windows

water_synergy.description: If lightning hits a water tile, the current spreads through all connected water tiles and shocks every unit standing in the water.

name: Grass
combo_signature: grows a zone then turns it into cover or a trap
internal_synergy: turns the team into a living defense line that grows stronger in place

name: Ice
combo_signature: turns a route into a wall, bridge or trap
internal_synergy: turns the team into a shaped battlefield where every ally can freeze or reroute the fight

resistance_rules.description: Ice users take 30% more damage from fire-based skills.

name: Ground
combo_signature: raises or lowers a whole section of the map
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a piece of a fortress that can be reshaped in real time

name: Flying
combo_signature: takes altitude and changes the angle of the fight
internal_synergy: makes the whole team act as a moving air lane that can outplay terrain itself

ground_effects.description: Wind magic does not transform terrain, but it applies a micro-push that turns the target and exposes its back for a critical follow-up attack.

name: Poison
combo_signature: contaminates a zone then triggers an explosion or decay
internal_synergy: makes every ally a persistent threat that turns the battlefield into a long-term trap

name: Psychic
combo_signature: moves a target or a block to create a tactical opening
internal_synergy: makes the team operate like a shifting battlefield where every ally can become a thread in a wider pattern

name: Metal
combo_signature: reinforces a structure then turns it into a heavy collision trap
internal_synergy: makes the team a fortress that can absorb pressure and transform it into counter-pressure

name: Shadow
combo_signature: uses darkness to break line of sight and isolate a target
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a predator that strikes from blind zones and breaks the enemy's attention

ground_effects.description: Shadow zones create invisible allies and blind enemies inside the area, reducing their effective range to 1 tile.

name: Ghost
combo_signature: crosses barriers and applies condemnation to the target
internal_synergy: turns the team into a phasing threat that ignores terrain and turns every fight into a clock

ground_effects.description: Ghost units may cross walls, roots, and cover without extra movement cost and can apply Condemnation, which kills the target after 3 turns.

name: Fairy
combo_signature: wraps allies in mystic mist and reduces physical damage
internal_synergy: makes the team resilient within a protective fog that turns every fight into a steady grind

ground_effects.description: Fairy zones protect allies from paralysis, freeze, poison, and other status effects while lowering physical damage taken.

name: Rock
combo_signature: raises pillars or collapses terrain to seal lanes
internal_synergy: turns the team into a defensive siege line that blocks sight and routes with fortification

ground_effects.description: Rock can create pillars and avalanches that permanently seal lines of sight or narrow passages.

name: Bug
combo_signature: locks enemies in a web and harasses them with swarms
internal_synergy: makes the team a perpetual nuisance that denies repositioning and exposes the enemy to sustained pressure

ground_effects.description: Bug webs anchor units in place and prevent being pushed or pulled.

name: Fighting
combo_signature: throws enemies into walls, ledges, or impact craters
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a collision engine that converts positioning into fatal momentum

ground_effects.description: Fighting attacks are built around violent projection, launching enemies into walls or down ledges for extra fall damage.

name: Dragon
combo_signature: charges the battlefield with brutal energy that punishes everyone standing on it
internal_synergy: turns every ally into a violent engine that increases damage in rage zones but denies defensive casts

ground_effects.description: Dragon zones are destructive powerfields: anyone standing on them takes a heavy damage boost and cannot cast defensive spells.
